moonstomp.definition:
To Moonstomp: a simple dance derived from earlier styles of reggae to associate with offbeat genres such as ska and dub. \r
\r
Despite popular belief, this does not have anything to do with violent acts with both feet upon one's head, and is wrongly thought to become associative with the extreme neo-fascist ideas of cult film "American History X"\r
\r
Despite unpopular belief, the term or idea wasn't made famous on Rancid's "Roots Radicals" song on the "Out Come The Wolves" album, neither.\r
\r
It is also referred to as "skanking", which has it's origins in Jamaica, also. This is a perfectly respectable name.\r
\r
To moonstomp conventionally, it is suggested that you raise your left leg along with your left arm and produce a low kicking movement towards the ground in front while making a slow and gentle "punching the air" movement with your fist, sweeping it behind your right leg and doing the same movement symmetrically with your right leg and right arm and thus repeating, to the rhythm and tempo of the ska or dub song, until the end of the song.
> "I want all you skinheads to get up on your feet, put your braces together and your boots on your feet and give me some of that old moonstomping……"

n deciduous shrub of eastern North America having tough flexible branches and pliable bark and small yellow flowers

moot.definition:
n. a hypothetical case that law students argue as an exercise
s. of no legal significance (as having been previously decided)
moot.translation:
n. 大会, 模拟案件, 辩论会
a. 未决议的, 无实际意义的
vt. 讨论, 争论

moot a case.translation: [法] 提出一个案件供辩论

moot case.translation: [法] 未决案, 假案, 提出讨论案

moot court.translation: [法] 模拟法庭, 实习法庭

moot point.translation: [法] 练习辩论的要点, 未决要点

mootable.translation: a. 无实际意义的；未决议的 (moot的变形)

mooted.translation: [美]未决定的, 有争议的, 有疑问的

mooter.definition: n. A disputer of a mooted case.

mooth.translation: [网络] 丝绸摸上去很光滑

moothy.definition:
Crazy, weird, outgoing, funny, boy crazy, dancer.
> Hey what's up?
> Nothin much just chilled with Moothy.

mooting.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Moot
mooting.translation: v. 提出…供讨论( moot的现在分词 )

moots.definition:
n a hypothetical case that law students argue as an exercise
v think about carefully; weigh
moots.translation: v. 提出…供讨论( moot的第三人称单数 )

moots's rule.translation: [医] 穆兹氏规律(麻醉术时脉压为心力的指征)

moots-mckesson ratio.translation: [医] 穆-麦二氏比率(脉压舒张压比率)
